scripts.verify:unit: vitest run && node scripts/success.mjs "frontend tests passed"
scripts.verify:mobile: npm run build && cap sync && node scripts/verify-mobile.mjs
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:unit && npm run verify:structure && npm run verify:design-source && npm run verify:visual-system && npm run verify:usability && npm run verify:build && npm run verify:mobile && node scripts/success.mjs "redesigned frontend release verification passed"
scripts.verify:backend: cd backend && ./mvnw -q verify && node ../scripts/success.mjs "backend verification passed"
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify:release && npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:k8s && npm run verify:e2e && node scripts/success.mjs "full stack verification passed"
scripts.app:ios: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
scripts.app:android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
